name: Endou Hiyori
source:
A streamer girl and habitual liar

She was born in Tokyo, but speaks in a Kansai dialect.
She is a popular streamer, who seeks attention
by telling unnecessary lies, albeit without malicious intent.
She has a past of hurting many of her fans through her activities...?

"I'll do my best with hyper power! Let's roll the video!"

[Edited from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2507560/_/]Steam page[/url]]
